scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Mantis?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
你已经猎杀了50只螳螂了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
嗯，我觉得你还没猎杀够50只。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Remember, I need help hunting Mantis so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀螳螂，所以去猎杀50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
你确定要停止猎杀吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
好的，如果你改变主意，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Please kill 50 Mantis in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
请猎杀50只螳螂，好让这里成为人们可以前往并获取经验的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
太棒了，你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
太好了！
你是来帮我的吧？
如果不是，我真不知道该怎么处理这里的魔物了！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Mantis around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
太好了！我一看到你，就知道可以指望你！
我需要你减少目前在这个地图上肆虐的魔物数量！
这里的螳螂太多了，导致低等级的玩家无法在这里获得良好的经验。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
那么，你还愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Thank you for your great help with the Mantis!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
非常感谢你帮我处理螳螂！
目前的情况已经稳定，我不再需要你帮忙猎杀它们了。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Kill 50 of those Mantis and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
猎杀50只螳螂，完成后告诉我。我会奖励你的付出。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
如果你改变主意，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
如果你改变主意，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Mantis are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
抱歉，我现在没法说话，我快被这些该死的螳螂逼疯了。
